description:
Add the project's documentation rules to the JIT invariant registry so they are addressable, projected into `AGENTS.md`, and citable by review gates.

## Background

The registry (`.jit/invariants.toml`) already holds `present-tense-prose`, `single-source-prose` and `benchmark-backed-performance`, and `[projection.invariants]` renders all invariants into the delimited region of the root `AGENTS.md`. The comment rule (non-obvious content only, shortest form, module orientation at most one short paragraph) exists only as hand-written `AGENTS.md` prose. Rules on current-state scope, rustdoc examples, active-document layout and `AGENTS.md` scope are not registered.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `@/inv/<id>` resolution and the `enforces` namespace are verified working for invariants, with the verification commands and output recorded in the linked draft document.
- [hard] REQ-02: A linked draft document proposes one-sentence texts and IDs for three rule groups: (a) comments and rustdoc carry only non-obvious content in the shortest form, with a module orientation of at most one short paragraph and no duplication; (b) documentation states current behavior and limits only, with no speculation, future promises, non-goals or deferrals; (c) rustdoc examples are non-trivial, active development documents live under `dev/active/<epic-short-id>-<slug>/` linked to their owning issues, and every `AGENTS.md` respects its recursive scope and 200-line limit.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every invariant text is approved by the user, with the approval recorded as a decision on this issue, before it is registered.
- [hard] REQ-04: The approved invariants are in the registry, the `AGENTS.md` projection region is regenerated deterministically, and content outside the region is byte-identical.
- [hard] REQ-05: Hand-written `AGENTS.md` prose that the new invariants supersede is removed, so each rule has one source, and `AGENTS.md` stays at or below 200 lines.
- [hard] REQ-06: `jit invariant check` and `jit validate` report no new findings.
title: Register and project the documentation invariants
